entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-11
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Obsolete Mvc.Api.Analyzers shipped in the framework #62689
  • Obsolete ConcurrencyLimiter #62686
    10.0-rc1
  • MapStaticAssets doesn't work for Content-Encoding "gzip" #62685
  • Perf regression: ApiCrudDeleteProduct #62684
  • Perf regression: multiple_queries, updates #62683
  • Perf improvement: fortunes, single_query #62682
  • Creating an MVC/Razor pages project with a space in its name breaks the styling #62679
  • QuickGrid: Add option to disable rendering of filler rows #62678
  • QuickGrid: Add EmptyContentTemplate #62677
  • QuickGrid: Add multi sort capabilities #62676
  • [Known Build Error] `NavigationException_InAsyncContext_DoesNotBecomeUnobservedTaskException` fails with `ObjectDisposedException` #62672
    10.0-rc1
  • Encountered unsupported frame type during diffing: None #62670
    10.0-preview7

Closed

  • Minimal API Validation throws when DB Context is passed `AsParameters` #62173
  • `GetValidationAttributes` needs updated DAM attributes in Validations source generator #62655
  • Creating a Blazor project with a space in its name breaks the styling #52196
    8.0.x
  • ASP.NET Core identity sign in metrics API #62131
  • Perf improvement: ApiCrudListProducts #62667
  • Perf improvement: json_middleware #62666
  • ASP.NET Core identity user metrics API #62132
  • New and improved `kestrel.connection.duration` tags: `error.type` and protocol error #56164
  • Add `ExceptionHandlerOptions.SuppressLoggingCallback` #59075
    10.0-preview7
  • Strange behavior with AddJwtBearer authentication policy that was working in .NET8 #62416
  • Deprecated Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer dependency #62493
  • NavigationManager.NavigateTo has no effect if called after a aynchronous method in OnIntializedAsync, in SSR mode #62519

PullRequests

Created

  • Add AppContext switch in patch release to opt-out of breaking behavior change in ForwardedHeaders middleware #62690
    Servicing-consider
  • [release/8.0] Add AppContext switch in patch release to opt-out of breaking behavior change in ForwardedHeaders middleware. #62688
    Servicing-consider, 8.0.x
  • Add AppContext switch in patch release to opt-out of breaking behavior change in ForwardedHeaders middleware. #62687
    Servicing-consider, 9.0.x
  • Fix MVC and Razor Pages scoped CSS styling for project names with spaces #62680
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • [Blazor] Rename LinkPreload to ResourcePreloader #62673
    area-blazor, 10.0-preview7
  • Replace _UNKNOWN with _OTHER in identity metrics #62671
    area-identity

Merged

  • Fix validation generator to ignore properties with [FromServices] or [FromKeyedServices] attributes #62669
    Attention: Shared Code Modified, 10.0-preview7
  • Fix DAM attributes in ValidationAttributeCache to include PublicConstructors #62656
    Attention: Shared Code Modified, 10.0-preview7
  • Harden Cookie Parsing #62681
    area-networking, 10.0-preview7
  • Fix. Creating a Blazor project with a space in its name breaks the styling #62675
    area-mvc, 10.0-preview7
  • [main] (deps): Bump dotnet/arcade from aea743edf7c9345cfdbdf9593756973baadc6b37 to 5a11b260f9b0f31b4e7643ad823a4e0f2cdb3ddb #62674
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, build-ops

Updated

  • Obsolete Microsoft.AspNetCore.HttpOverrides.IPNetwork #62490
    blocked, community-contribution, area-networking
  • Dispose the certificate chain elements with the chain #62531
    area-auth, community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun
  • Support `NotFound` content rendering for a custom Router #62635
    area-blazor, 10.0-preview7
  • [blazor] fix multiple calls to OnConnectionDownAsync #62518
    area-blazor, pending-ci-rerun, 10.0-preview7
  • Add CreateScopeForStatusCodePages property and UseStatusCodePagesWithReExecute overload #62624
    Attention: Shared Code Modified, 10.0-preview7
  • Improve SSR navigation tests #62536
    area-blazor, 10.0-preview7
  • Add validation to Router component to prevent both NotFound and NotFoundPage being set #62625
    Attention: Shared Code Modified, 10.0-preview7
  • QuickGrid: Adds option to disable rendering of filler rows #62607
    area-blazor, community-contribution
  • QuickGrid: Adds EmptyContentTemplate #62603
    area-blazor, community-contribution
  • QuickGrid: Adds Multi Column Sorting #62604
    area-blazor, community-contribution
  • Prevent `ObjectDisposedException` from becoming unobserved during circuit cleanup #62662
    area-blazor, 10.0-preview7
  • HostingMetrics: empty "http.route" tags shouldn't be present #62432
    community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun, area-hosting
  • Wrap OnNavigateTo callback with GetErrorHandledTask for proper exception logging #62414
    area-blazor, Attention: Shared Code Modified, 10.0-preview7
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #62664
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, build-ops
